prompt:
A real photograph of the inside of a suburban train running along the sea from Lisbon to Cascais on a sunny July afternoon, in a tall vertical picture made of one single continuous view, caught as it happens, as a passenger would take it with a good phone camera. Taken with a 24 mm lens at sitting eye height from the seat across the aisle, everything in sharp focus. Bright sunlight through the windows and the blue glitter of the sea; the textures of real plastic seats, glass, paper, ink, cotton and skin.

The first reference picture shows the young man from the front, the second shows him from his side: his face, his wavy dark-brown hair, his short stubble, his build and his height stay exactly as in them; it is summer, and he wears only his white t-shirt, the cream scarf with small blue embroidered flowers, light-grey shorts and his white canvas sneakers, and his royal-blue sweatshirt is tied around his waist by its sleeves.

Every surface in the picture is plain: the seats are plain blue, the notebook pages are plain cream with lines of handwriting too small to read, and the clothes are plain cloth. Each object stands clearly on its own, with a band of bare seat or bare window around it, so that the eye can tell at once where everything is.

The picture is built in three bands, from the bottom edge to the top edge.

THE FOREGROUND, along the bottom of the picture:
- the young man of the reference pictures sits by the window on the left, seen from his head down to his knees; his body is turned in three-quarter view towards the right of the picture; he writes in his open orange notebook on his knees, frowning with concentration, a pen in his hand;
- opposite him, an old man in a straw hat and a white shirt leans forward and points with one finger at a word in the notebook, kindly correcting it, while the young man looks up at him, surprised and grateful.

THE MIDDLE OF THE CARRIAGE, from left to right:
- other passengers: a girl with headphones, a mother with a beach bag and a child with a bucket and spade.

THE WINDOWS, across the upper third of the picture:
- through the large windows, the sea glitters right beside the track, with a lighthouse and a fort on the shore;
- a clear summer sky.

The carriage is calm and bright: between the people, the same bare floor and the same bare windows.
